tools.name: list_packs
tools.description:
B2B lead packs for sale: sizes, prices, and a redacted sample. Free.
    Verified business lead enrichment batches (company, contact, verified email).

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description:
Get the exact x402 payment requirements and step-by-step buying flow
    for a Scout Pack. pack: "25", "50", or "100".
    Returns what the buying agent must do; the agent's own wallet executes
    the USDC payment against the endpoint.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_packs · Private data: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead · Public sink: list_packs, lookup_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_packs · Private data: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead · Public sink: list_packs, lookup_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
